name: Color Ring
summary: Dive into the vibrant world of Color Ring, an addictive and fast-paced arcade matching game that tests your reflexes and hand-eye coordination. Your goal is simple: rotate the glowing neon ring to catch the falling ball with the matching colored segment. As your score increases, the balls drop faster, challenging you to stay focused and react in a split second. With stunning neon colors and mesmerizing particle effects, Color Ring offers a visually stunning and satisfying hypercasual gameplay experience.
